Dhaleshwari Poly Pack
QUOTATION
Quotation no. QT-2026-909 Date 2026-10-22
To Aamar Garments Ltd (fictional) Reference PR-2026-114
Item Description Qty Unit Unit price (BDT) Amount (BDT)
D Poly bag, 30 x 40 cm 50,000 piece 6.40 322,000.00
Subtotal 322,000.00
VAT 15% 48,300.00
Total 370,300.00
Supplier TIN: 109458093391 BIN: 000970941-0101
TERMS AND CONDITIONS
1. Payment. 5% advance payable with the purchase order. Payment within 30 to 90 days as agreed by both
parties.
2. Delivery. Delivery within 4 weeks of PO.
3. Delay. Late delivery penalty of 0.5% of order value per week.
4. Validity. This quotation is valid for 30 days from the date above.
5. Quality. Goods are supplied as per the buyer's approved sample. Defective goods will be replaced at the
supplier's cost.
6. Disputes. Any dispute will first be settled by discussion; failing that, through arbitration in Dhaka.
For Dhaleshwari Poly Pack
Authorised signatory (fictional sample document)
